notes: §1985:XIV.3.3.2 prints ENABLE {INPUT [TERMINAL] | I-O TERMINAL | OUTPUT} cd-name-1 [WITH KEY {identifier-1 | literal-1}]; enableStatement with communicationPath and communicationKeyPhrase parses exactly that, BindEnable/BindPath bind it, and the edition pass gates the statement and the KEY phrase only from 2002/2014, so 85 reaches the whole format. Witness: ENABLE OUTPUT TERMINAL refused COBOL0901. Probes at --std 85 (b): no path word, I-O without TERMINAL, OUTPUT TERMINAL, INPUT TERMINAL TERMINAL, INPUT OUTPUT, a bare TERMINAL, zero operands, two cd-names, WITH KEY with no operand, KEY KEYX KEYX, KEY written twice, WITH without KEY are each refused (COBOL0307/5506/0001/0901/2269); every legal arm (INPUT, INPUT TERMINAL, I-O TERMINAL, OUTPUT; KEY with and without WITH; literal, identifier, ref-mod, ALL literal, SPACES, alphanumeric function) translates and runs (statuses 21/21/30 with no MCS defined, class e). (c) at 85 the 2002+ operand forms N"AB", X"41", "A" & "B" and FUNCTION CONCAT are refused COBOL0900/1502; the KEY phrase is COBOL0902 from 2002 and the statement COBOL0902 at 2014/2023. (d) a numeric, numeric-edited, alphabetic, 18-digit or negative KEY operand is COBOL6171 (SR4).

next.reason: 1985: "ENABLE { INPUT [ TERMINAL ] | I-O TERMINAL | OUTPUT } cd-name-1 [ WITH KEY { identifier-1 | literal-1 } ]"; 2023: "No ENABLE statement or communication module; no candidate clause holds the feature, and the wording matches cover only CANCEL, OPEN, USE and screen clauses.". No 2023 clause holds the communication feature, and no candidate gives an ENABLE format or a cd-name. The 2023 standard lacks the communication module, so the ENABLE statement is dropped.
